reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited paragraphs (5.4 liaison/General Manager appointment; 10.2 no joint venture) contain no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant binding the Company, so the preferred position ('no non-solicit on Customer') is satisfied.
No redline or counterparty comment is expected or present for a compliant finding; the rendered redline correctly leaves the original text unchanged.
The failing deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are not applicable because there is no non-solicit clause to constrain; they do not indicate a defect here.
Rationale correctly scopes out Section 6 exclusivity (product/market non-compete) as outside this personnel-covenant rule.
